scope: Companion no longer freezes when the Windows voice stops answering.

topics.title: Speech that comes back by itself
details: If the Windows voice stops answering, Companion starts a new voice after a few seconds.
It keeps your voice, speed and volume.

topics.title: No more freezes from speech
details: Companion could freeze at startup if the Windows voice stopped answering.
The window still showed your typing, but no key or command worked.
Now your keys and commands keep working, even while the voice is stuck.
